notes:
Customer: mid-size clinical software vendor focused on physician-facing search across EHR/clinical notes. They emphasized PHI-first controls.
- Corpus: ~40M clinical notes, 12TB compressed; expects quarterly growth ~8-12%.
- Requirements: near-real-time indexing (daily delta), embeddings store with strong encryption at rest, reranking on top of ANN candidate retrieval, per-query pipeline: embed -> ANN -> 100 candidates -> rerank (cross-encoder) -> top-5 answers.
- Latency targets: 50ms for embedding lookup, 120-200ms p95 end-to-end for short queries including rerank (goal 150ms p95).
- Throughput: 50 QPS sustained with bursts to 200 QPS during peak clinic hours.
- Cost sensitivity: aiming for <$0.02 per query total (including retrieval + rerank) at steady state. Very focused on cost per query tradeoffs (quantization, batching, cheaper rerank models, fallback to cheaper model for low-confidence queries).
- Security: PHI controls mandatory, SSO/SAML, per-request audit logs, data residency in US-only regions, customer-managed KMS, optional air-gapped on-prem trial.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable tail latency and an auditable pipeline — if we can't prove it, we can't deploy."
- Internal stakeholders: CTO, Head of Clinical Informatics, Legal/Compliance, Platform Engineering.
- Preferred models: open 2-4B dense models for embeddings, smaller cross-encoders for rerank, quantized for cost; open to Redwood-verified model profiles.
- Integration notes: wants native VPC peering, no public egress from inference nodes, support for on-prem fallback for isolated clinics.
- Data transfer: willing to share synthetic and redacted sample set for benchmarking; legal needs DPA addendum and HIPAA BAAs.
- POC success criteria: validate <200ms p95 end-to-end at 50 qps, recall@100 >= 0.95 for relevant doc labeling, cost <$0.02/query in POC config.
use_case_summary: RAG-enabled enterprise search over EHR/clinical notes using embeddings for coarse recall and cross-encoder reranking for precision. Primary goals: strict PHI controls, US residency, VPC/on-prem deployment options, predictable latency and low cost per query at scale.
indexing_requirements: Target index: ~40M documents; embedding dim 768-1536; ANN library preference: HNSW for latency-sensitive, but evaluating IVF+PQ for cost/space; nightly full snapshot + hourly deltas; expected index storage after compression/quantization ~6-12TB; shard strategy: per-clinic logical shards, global reranker service.
poc_notes: POC plan: 2-week performance run. Phase 1: ingest 1M synthetic notes, validate pipeline correctness. Phase 2: scale to 10M and 40M, run steady 50 QPS, measure p50/p95 latency, token costs, mem/GC on nodes, failover behavior. Deliverable: performance report + configuration recommendations (batching, quantization, cache TTLs).
